story_type: boat fire, three people abandon ship in survival suits, good Samaritan pulls them out, Coast Guard boat meets them
hook: Their boat caught fire. All three went into the sea.
narration: Their forty foot boat was on fire, so all three people aboard went over the side in survival suits.
It happened near Protection Island, Washington.
A survival suit is a full body foam suit that keeps a person floating and holds off the cold water.
A good Samaritan boat was close by.
A Coast Guard response boat from Station Port Angeles raced out to meet it.
The two crews came alongside each other on open water.
Behind them, the boat they had escaped kept burning.
outcome: The good Samaritan crew had pulled all three people from the water.
title: Boat on fire, all three went overboard
description:
A 40-foot recreational vessel with three people aboard caught fire near Protection Island, Washington, on June 11, 2018. The three abandoned ship in survival suits and a good Samaritan pulled them from the water, then met a Coast Guard Station Port Angeles 45-foot response boat crew.
